Ready to start a new job?

Looking for an active warehouse job?

Start your next job at GXO Logistics in Tilburg!

Work in a modern warehouse with an international team. You will pick, pack, and ship customer orders correctly and on time.

No warehouse experience? That's okay! If you are motivated, willing to learn, and like to stay active, we will train you and help you grow.

Please note: This is an active, physical job. You'll be walking, standing and moving throughout your shift.

What will you do?

As a Warehouse Employee, you can work in different departments.

Order Picking

- Pick products using a hand scanner.
- Collect the correct items for customer orders.
- Make sure orders are complete.

Packing

- Scan products.
- Check orders before shipment.
- Print shipping labels.

Returns

- Inspect returned products.
- Decide whether products can be returned to stock.
- Process returns in the warehouse system.

Together with your colleagues, you'll ensure every product is handled carefully from the moment it arrives until it leaves the warehouse.

What do we ask?

- You speak and understand basic English (minimum B1).
- You are available full-time or part-time.
- You enjoy active work and are physically fit.
- You can stand and walk throughout your shift.
- You have your own accommodation and transportation.
- You can apply for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG).

Working hours in aTwo-shift system

Morning: 06:00 - 14:45

Afternoon: 15:15 - 00:00

DISCOVER THIS WAY Ready to be part of a vibrant, fun team with exciting opportunities to grow?  Do you have a love for hospitality, great food and creating unforgettable guest experiences? Do you enjoy connecting with guests from all over the world, especially those who appreciate the little details? Then we would love to welcome you as our next Janine Waiter in a brand new vibrant setting! What will you do?As a Janine Waiter, you play a key role in delivering a premium guest experience. You will be the welcoming face they see each day: the one who remembers their coffee order, anticipates their needs before they speak and helps them feel right at home.What makes you the perfect fit? We are looking for new colleagues are curious, full of personality and love connecting with people through great food and service. You bring energy to the room, spot the little details and enjoy discovering hidden gems of the city.  We are looking for people who:  
• Have experience in hospitality and love all things food & drink.  
• Can communicate confidently in English and preferably Dutch. 
• Flexible in working mornings, evenings and weekends. 
• Can work full-time and are ready to grow with us.  
• Are eligible to work in the Netherlands.If this sounds like you, you're in the right place at the Renaissance Amsterdam Hotel. Renaissance is not just a place to spend the night, it's a place to discover, a place in the world with style like yours. That is why we are not just looking for anyone, we are looking for you! Here is what you can look forward to: Located just moments from Amsterdam Central Station, the Renaissance Amsterdam Hotel is entering an exciting new chapter and we invite you to be part of it.    
• An inspiring and professional environment that nurtures creativity and personal development.     
• Travel allowance to make your daily commute easier.   
• € 25 gross for every written positive guest mention.
• Bonus for employee referral, more friends = more bonuses!
